title: Euroleague Championship day, CSKA prevails as the new kings
description: The third place game was between the two ACB powers Tau and Barcelona. The arena was partially filled in the first half because most of the ticket holders were Maccabi fans who arrived later for the big game. Both of these teams were very familiar with each other tactics. Tau raced out to an early 26-19 lead behind the play of Travis Hansen (198-G/F-78, college: BYU) despite Luis Scola picking up two early fouls in the opening period.
